sources.title: Spokane Conservation District — Spokane River Restored Access Points, Sullivan Park section
sources.accessEvidence: Sullivan Park has two north-bank access points, one near the bridge and another about 500 yards downstream; both serve smaller boats and pedestrians. The District says boulders and post-and-rail fencing guide users to the entries. Includes a Sullivan Road north-bank photo.
sources.interpretation: Confirms a public, foot-accessible launch/exit near the bridge but does not publish coordinates.

sources.title: City of Spokane Valley — Sullivan Park facility page
sources.accessEvidence: Lists Spokane River access at the City park at 1901 N Sullivan Road, with public park and parking amenities.

sources.title: Spokane River Water Trail — launch list
sources.accessEvidence: Lists Sullivan Park as a canoe/kayak/SUP launch in the State Line-to-Upriver Dam reach.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite imagery inspected 2026-09-18
sources.interpretation: The bridge-side north-bank footpath meets the Spokane River at this point. Estimated uncertainty about 50 feet; not surveyed.

sources.title: USGS National Hydrography Dataset flowline, area, and waterbody services
sources.interpretation: After the imagery-derived correction, both route endpoints are on mapped water and roughly four feet from the matched river flowline.
